alternatives: Keep plan §4 P06 scope verbatim; defer spec internalization to v0.1.1
D01.rationale: Plan §4 lists P06 as Hardening + GA (Linux polish, golden scenarios, release tag). Phase 6 reframed to (a) internalize the v0.1 design spec into docs/, (b) dogfood eawf on its own repo, (c) ship the v0.1 PR. The displaced hardening work is captured in v0.2 backlog items B001 (Linux CI matrix), B009 (golden scenarios), B010 (v0.1.0 release tag).
D01.summary: P06 rescope: spec internalization + dogfood instead of plan §4 'Hardening + GA'

alternatives: python-callable-only (every check needs a code change)
D02.rationale: Bottleneck is non-coders authoring audits, not expressing arbitrary logic. YAML + registry of built-in kinds (file_exists, regex_match, json_path_value, pytest_pass, coverage_min, numeric_threshold, command_exit_zero) lets check-authors stay in YAML; new kinds are a code change. Hybrid escape hatch can come later if real example pushes against the registry.
D02.summary: B019 audit-check DSL: yaml declarative + check-kind registry

alternatives: audit link required at hypothesis open time
D03.rationale: Audit link gates the commitment, not the exploration. Forcing audit at hypothesis open time forces premature audit design; making it fully optional fails the verify-before-claim rule. Permissive open + required audit on set-verdict matches the dogfood workflow.
D03.summary: B020 hypothesis lifecycle: audit-link required at set-verdict only

D04.rationale: Local file integrity is cheap to enforce; URL integrity is a different problem (provenance + fetch policy). Mandatory-everywhere couples the registry to network state at registration. eawf artifact verify recomputes on demand for both cases.
D04.summary: B021 artifact registry: sha256 mandatory for files, optional for URLs

D05.rationale: Phase close is the natural integrity boundary; manual run is the escape hatch for debugging. Every-mutation is too slow on hot paths like wave dispatch; manual-only is easy to forget. Failures block phase close; --force requires audit reason so the bypass is recorded.
D05.summary: B022 integrity runner: auto on phase close + opt-in eawf validate --integrity

alternatives: ship the verbs as a P06 follow-up commit before tagging v0.1.0
D06.rationale: v0.1 CLI lacks 'eawf audit set-verdict' and 'eawf backlog set-priority' verbs. Hand-editing state.json would violate AGENTS.md rule 4 (state CLI is the only mutator). Safer to ship the verbs in P07 and do the retro-stamping (A01..A06 verdicts; B015/B017 P2->P1) at P07 closeout in one pass.
D06.summary: Defer retro audit-verdict + backlog priority-bumps to P07 CLI completeness

alternatives: squash-merge (collapses history; rejected — incident 2026-05-10 PR #3 squashed by ship skill, reverted via force-push, redone as rebase-merge in PR #4)
D07.rationale: Squash collapses per-wave/per-commit history into a single fat commit on main, losing the symbol-prefixed audit trail (e.g. [P06-W05] [P06-CORE]) that AGENTS.md commit-prefix rule and the wave/audit chain depend on for reconstructibility from git log. Rebase-merge preserves linear, individual commits with their original messages — matches the cherry-pick discipline that already feeds the long-running phase branch. Merge-commits forbidden by repo settings (mergeCommitAllowed=false). Default for all phase PRs unless explicitly overridden.
D07.summary: PR merge strategy: rebase-and-merge; never squash, never merge-commit

alternatives: Adopt review-driven PR cadence immediately (rejected: mid-game policy churn)
Lock per-phase PR forever (rejected: pre-decides v0.2.0 retro)
D08.rationale: User proposed shifting from per-phase PR to review-driven + version-bump PR mid-v0.2. Mid-stream workflow change = state-of-record drift risk; defer re-evaluation to v0.2.0 cut, when iter/phase aggregation pattern is fully exercised.
D08.summary: Defer PR-cadence policy change until v0.2.0 ship

alternatives: Ship PyPI in P13 alongside tag v0.2.0 (rejected: scope creep)
D09.rationale: v0.2 scope locked at P13; PyPI publish needs maintainer-track decision + CI release gating + tag-driven workflow not yet in place. Park behind tag v0.2.0 ship and reopen as v0.3 epic.
D09.summary: Defer B005 PyPI publish to v0.3

alternatives: Multi-phase rolling PR (rejected: rebase history becomes noisy, hard to revert one phase)
D10.rationale: D08 deferred the cadence policy revisit to v0.2.0 ship. Reviewed at P13 open: one-PR-per-phase produced clean rebase-merge history across P07..P12 and aligns with AGENTS.md phase lifecycle. Keep cadence; reopen for v0.3 only if multi-phase PRs become necessary.
D10.summary: Revisit D08 — keep one-PR-per-phase cadence through v0.2 close

alternatives: Roll v0.3 features into P13 (rejected: violates phase-bounded scope, delays tag)
D11.rationale: P13 is the v0.2.0 ship-gate phase. Scope = backlog hygiene (W01) + 4 net-new features (W02 B009, W04 B019, W05 B015, W07 B017) + B042 (W03) + version bump (W06) + CORE final. Additional waves block tag and re-trigger CI; add via decision ADR only.
